title: Jumpr Management Meeting - Transcript (internal)

items.statement: Waleed states the team must work out what is needed to go live on November 1.
items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: So honestly, man, whatever you need, but we gotta figure out what we need to go live November one. But that's it.

items.statement: Waleed proposes telling the client that Friday is the last day to add scope, so that the team can go live. Internal assent only; the client has not confirmed this cutoff in this meeting.
items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: Friday is the last day of adding,… / Kobi Kunasekaran: It's great. / Waleed Alasadi: is that true? Could we say that that's true? / Miko Sumagang: All right. / Waleed Alasadi: Can we go to them tomorrow and say that's what we wanted? that's it. we can't take in anymore to be able to go live.

items.topic: Client meeting moved; map remaining scope
items.statement: Kobi says he moved the client meeting to Wednesday and that the team will map out the remaining items.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I moved the meeting to Wednesday. but yes we'll map out everything else and… / Waleed Alasadi: Okay.

items.statement: Kobi reports that the client keeps asking for more items, that Jumpr told them non-critical items get pushed to a later phase, and that the client accepted this. Prioritization is the focus for the next week.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: then we are at the point they're asking for more things and we've already said if this isn't critical let's push it to me too and they're good with it. So that will prioritize. ization is going to be the name of the game for the next week.

items.statement: Kobi says many design items are backlogged with him and much build work remains for the added scope, with limited capacity to complete it all.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah, just bunch of the stuff is backlogged on me for the design. and then there's quite a bit of build work to do as not enough hands to work through them all the additional stuff that we've added. Yeah.
